0022600110.text: Both teams are 0-1 as they meet, with the Pelicans on a one-game losing streak, sitting 9th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 1 game back, while the Nuggets are 10th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back. The Pelicans lost the 2025-26 season series 0-3, including a 122-116 defeat in New Orleans on January 13, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series. Yves Missi is day-to-day with a knee issue and is a game-time decision for New Orleans, while Denver is without Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Alpha Diallo is day-to-day with a wrist injury and a game-time decision.
